item.title: SEC releases notice of proposed rulemaking on token offerings, broker-dealer crypto custody, and digital-asset trading venues.
Six US agencies finalize GENIUS Act stablecoin rules ahead of July 18 one-year anniversary deadline.
MiCA transitional period closed July 1; unlicensed crypto-asset service providers are now in breach of EU law.
ESMA launches coordinated supervisory review of crypto custodians' digital operational resilience under MiCA and DORA.
Bitcoin and Ethereum protocols lose $35M in three separate exploits within hours on July 23.
Wanchain-Cardano bridge exploit drains 515M NIGHT tokens worth $13M; bridge suspended pending investigation.
Crypto hacks total $972M across 207 incidents in H1 2026; Drift Protocol suffers $295M, the largest single event.
Spot Ethereum ETFs attract $196M net inflows in the week to July 21; BlackRock ETHA leads all funds.
Spain's Cecabank launches MiCA-licensed institutional crypto custody; Renta 4 Banco is first client.
Citadel- and Fidelity-backed EDX Markets applies for US trust bank charter to add crypto custody and principal trading.
JPMorgan increases Bitcoin ETF exposure by 174% in Q1 2026, disclosures show.
OCC sets $5M minimum capital for GENIUS Act stablecoin issuers; FDIC confirms no deposit insurance for token holders.
California Digital Financial Assets Law adds mandatory crypto licensing regime, effective July 1, 2026.
